strategy_summary: In the final round, defect: against a defection this improves good-player payoff, and against cooperation it limits the loss if P6 defects or is selfish. Retain prior identity beliefs; the cooperative record does not prove objectives.
Defect against P2 given their repeated observed defections; cooperate with reliable partners to support good-player welfare.

P3’s verified defection against P5 raises concern despite our prior mutual cooperation. Defect this round; update identity beliefs from observed actions and support cooperation with reliable partners.
Defect against P6 after their admitted exploitation of P3; retain high suspicion of P2 from repeated defections. Cooperate with reliable partners to maximize good players’ combined payoff.
